children: According to ChainCatcher, crypto wallet Keplr has suspended Google and Apple social login after users reported unauthorized transactions on their accounts. Keplr said in an initial assessment that accounts restored with a seed phrase or using a hardware wallet were unaffected. It advised users who created accounts through social login to stop transferring funds into them.

title: Keplr Suspends Google and Apple Logins After Unauthorized Transactions Reported
